title: Skilled-referenced structured diagnosis of individual tennis forehand technique: data and code
description: Phase-normalised joint angles (15 players, 322 tennis forehand strokes recorded with Perception Neuron 3 Pro at 60 Hz), stroke metadata, diagnostic results, language-model inputs, outputs and DeepSeek-V4-Pro judgements, and the Python analysis code for the article submitted to Sports (MDPI). Raw joint-centre trajectories are available from the corresponding author on request. Data: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT.
